verdict.rationale: Datalab documents pipelines (versioned, reusable processor chains deployable to production), webhooks for job completion, a CLI, and an SDK. None of the evidence describes a scheduler, cron triggers, or any recurring-run capability. Pipelines and webhooks are triggered per request or one-off, so they are adjacent features and not recurring scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
